mapper.sql: CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(owner_account_id AS CHAR) AS ownerAccountId,usage_type AS usageType,original_name AS originalName, storage_path AS storagePath,mime_type AS mimeType,file_size AS size,CAST(thread_id AS CHAR) AS threadId,CAST(draft_id AS CHAR) AS draftId, CAST(profile_account_id AS CHAR) AS profileAccountId,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM forum_attachment WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(a.id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(a.owner_account_id AS CHAR) AS ownerAccountId,a.usage_type AS usageType,a.original_name AS originalName, a.storage_path AS storagePath,a.mime_type AS mimeType,a.file_size AS size,CAST(a.thread_id AS CHAR) AS threadId,CAST(a.draft_id AS CHAR) AS draftId, CAST(a.profile_account_id AS CHAR) AS profileAccountId,DATE_FORMAT(a.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM forum_attachment a LEFT JOIN forum_thread t ON t.id=a.thread_id AND t.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN forum_member pm ON pm.account_id=a.profile_account_id AND ( (a.usage_type='AVATAR' AND pm.avatar_attachment_id=a.id) OR (a.usage_type='PROFILE_COVER' AND pm.cover_attachment_id=a.id)) WHERE a.id=#{id} AND (t.id IS NOT NULL OR pm.account_id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT FROM forum_attachment WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND usage_type='ATTACHMENT' ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM forum_attachment WHERE draft_id=#{draftId} ORDER BY usage_type,id
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_attachment SET draft_id=NULL WHERE draft_id=#{draftId} AND thread_id IS NULL
UPDATE forum_attachment SET draft_id=#{draftId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_account_id=#{accountId} AND thread_id IS NULL AND (draft_id IS NULL OR draft_id=#{draftId})
UPDATE forum_attachment SET thread_id=#{threadId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_account_id=#{accountId} AND thread_id IS NULL AND draft_id IS NULL
UPDATE forum_attachment SET thread_id=#{threadId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_account_id=#{accountId} AND thread_id IS NULL AND (draft_id IS NULL OR draft_id=#{draftId})
UPDATE forum_attachment SET profile_account_id=NULL WHERE profile_account_id=#{accountId} AND usage_type=#{usageType} AND (#{keepId} IS NULL OR id!=#{keepId})
UPDATE forum_attachment SET profile_account_id=#{accountId} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_account_id=#{accountId} AND usage_type=#{usageType} AND thread_id IS NULL AND draft_id IS NULL
